Extra practice дай наприкінці уроку, якщ: Use Extra practice at the end of the lesson if there is time left, or at the start of the next one as revision. In the translation, answers with a, the and plural forms are accepted (Monkeys are funny). In the game «Animal riddles» the child reads each riddle aloud and writes the animal in English. The riddles about the penguin and the zebra start the same way, so ask the child to read to the end. Homework plus can go together with the «my zoo» drawing.

Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form.
вмиватися: to clean your face with water
чистити зуби: to clean your teeth with a toothbrush
йти до школи: to travel to school for lessons
гратися: to have fun with toys or games
Extra practice підходить для кінця уроку: Extra practice works for the end of the lesson or for revision in the next one. The key point in the gap exercise: -s only after he / she / it (Tom, My mum, Max, My brother), and no -s after I and They. Special forms to pay attention to: goes, does, has, and brushes in Homework plus (after sh we add -es). In the game the child writes the form for he / she; if they write have = haves, remind them of the rule from the tip. Give Homework plus together with the «My day» comic.
Extra practice можна зробити в кінці уро: Extra practice can be done at the end of the lesson or as a warm-up next time. Remind the child that the short answer repeats do: Yes, I do / No, I don’t, so «Так, люблю» is Yes, I do. In the game «Food riddles» read the riddles together first, and show the word cows with a gesture (moo). Give Homework plus together with the «crazy menu» drawing.
Встав слово: pizza, milk, soup, banana,: Fill in the word: pizza, milk, soup, banana, chocolate, popcorn.
Fill in am, is or are.
Extra practice для кінця уроку або повто: Extra practice is for the end of the lesson or for revision in the next one. In the gap exercise both full and short forms are accepted (am / ’m, is / ’s, are / ’re). When translating «I’m wearing shorts» the child often writes I wear shorts; explain that for right now, at this minute, we say I’m wearing. Homework plus can be combined with the «weather diary»: the writing questions are the first entry.
Встав слово: boots, scarf, umbrella, sho: Fill in the word: boots, scarf, umbrella, shorts, hat, jacket.
Fill in have got or has got.
сестра: a girl who has the same parents as you
домашній улюбленець: an animal you keep at home
Extra practice для кінця уроку або повто: Extra practice is for the end of the lesson or for revision in the next one. Before the game, repeat the rule: he / she / it and one name (Tom, Max, Grandpa) take has got, while I / you / we / they and two people (My aunt and uncle) take have got. In the question about Max (… Max got a brother?) the answer is Has, because Max is he. Give Homework plus together with the family tree.
У моєї тітки є кіт: My aunt has got a cat
Who is it? Write the word.
дощ: water that falls from the clouds
парасолька: a thing you hold over your head when it rains
хлюпати, бризкати: to hit water so that it flies around
Extra practice для кінця уроку або як ро: Extra practice is for the end of the lesson or as a warm-up in the next one. The word dry is new, show it as the opposite of wet. In the game pay attention to the double letter: swimming, running, and to the dropped e: dancing, riding. Give Homework plus together with the «me on a rainy day» drawing.
